message.content:
A structured wool-blend blazer, relaxed fit, knee-length hem, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy twill fabric.
Tailored linen trousers, straight leg, ankle length, warm beige (#D2B48C), crisp cotton-linen blend.
A soft merino knit sweater, crew neck, hip-length cut, rust orange (#B7410E), fine gauge wool.
Round-toe leather loafers, medium heel, flat sole for comfort on cobblestones, chestnut brown (#91523D), smooth full-grain leather.
A structured felt fedora hat, wide brim, tan brown (#C19A6B), dense felt material.
A woven straw tote bag with leather straps, medium size, natural beige (#E8DCD0), sturdy raffia weave.

This ensemble balances the need for warmth and structure against the cool autumn air while prioritizing comfort for a full day of walking on uneven cobblestones. The relaxed fit blazer and breathable linen trousers allow for unrestricted movement in the park setting without sacrificing the polished look of a "neat" or elevated "everyday" style. Warm, earthy tones like rust and chestnut harmonize beautifully with the natural fall foliage, creating a cohesive and stylish silhouette that transitions effortlessly from morning daylight to afternoon strolls.
